items.title: 9.8 Solubility product (kam halne wale ionic compounds ke liye) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 9.8 (Solubility Product) with Table 9.5, printed pages 201-202.

blocks.text: Jab NaCl jaisa halne wala ionic compound pani mein hal ho to woh poori tarah ions mein dissociate hota hai, magar kam halne wale salts ke liye equilibrium par dissociation mukammal nahi hota. Jab PbSO4 pani ke saath hilaya jaye to solution mein Pb2+, SO4 2- aur ghair-dissociated PbSO4 hote hain, to thos solute aur hal shuda ions ke darmiyan equilibrium maujood hai. Lead sulphate mashhoor kam halne wala (sparingly soluble) compound hai aur PbCl2 ki tarah bohat kam dissociate hota hai: PbSO4(s) se Pb2+(aq) + SO4 2-(aq), Kc = [Pb2+][SO4 2-] / [PbSO4] ke saath. Kam halne ki wajah se PbSO4 ki concentration taqreeban mustaqil rehti hai aur Kc ke saath baen le jai jati hai: Kc [PbSO4] = [Pb2+][SO4 2-], aur Kc [PbSO4] = Ksp ke saath, Ksp = [Pb2+][SO4 2-] = 1.6 x 10^-8 25 degrees C par.

blocks.title: Solubility product
blocks.text: Ksp, kam halne wale salt ka solubility product, equilibrium par us ke ions ki molar solubilities ka hasil-e-zarb hai, har concentration balanced muadle ke coefficient ke barabar power par uthai hui. PbCl2 ke liye Ksp = [Pb2+][Cl-]^2. Ksp kamre ke darja hararat par aam taur par bohat chhoti miqdar hai, us ki qeemat darja hararat par munhasir hai, aur yeh kam halne wale salt ke dissociation ka paimana hai.

blocks.caption: Kuch kam halne wale ionic compounds ki Ksp qeematein (Table 9.5)

blocks.prompt: Ag2CrO4, Al(OH)3 aur Fe2S3 ke Ksp expressions likhein, aur batayein ke thos un mein kyun nahi aata.
blocks.explanation: Ag2CrO4: Ksp = [Ag+]^2 [CrO4 2-]; Al(OH)3: Ksp = [Al3+][OH-]^3; Fe2S3: Ksp = [Fe3+]^2 [S2-]^3. Ghair-hal shuda thos bari miqdar mein hai aur us ki concentration mustaqil, to use Kc mein zarb de kar Ksp banaya jata hai, bilkul jaise pani Kw mein shamil hua.

items: Pani mein kam halne wala salt: thos apne ions ke saath equilibrium mein; Ksp = Kc [thos] = ion concentrations ka hasil-e-zarb apne coefficients par (PbSO4 1.6 x 10^-8; PbCl2 = [Pb2+][Cl-]^2); bohat chhota, darja hararat par munhasir, dissociation ka paimana.
Table 9.5 MgCO3 3.5 x 10^-8 aur PbSO4 1.6 x 10^-8 se Fe2S3 1.4 x 10^-85 tak.
